conditions.name: Atrial Fibrillation with Rapid Ventricular Response

structured_clinical_data.vitals_summary: BP 124/80, HR 74 in controlled Afib, RR 16, SpO2 97% on room air.
structured_clinical_data.deidentified_text: [PATIENT] 79yo admitted for rate control in Afib. Polypharmacy noted on home medication reconciliation.

raw_context.admission_notes: 79-year-old female admitted for symptomatic Atrial Fibrillation with RVR. Converted to rate-controlled Afib on Amiodarone. Multiple psychoactive and cardiac medications on active profile.
raw_context.medication_list: Amiodarone 200mg PO daily; Citalopram 40mg PO daily (flagged drug-drug interaction: severe additive QTc prolongation risk); Apixaban 5mg PO BID; Tramadol PRN (missing dose); Omeprazole 20mg daily.
raw_context.lab_summary: Electrolytes normal: K 4.1, Mg 2.2. Baseline ECG shows QTc 478ms. No pending lab tests.
raw_context.caregiver_notes: Patient lives alone on 3rd floor apartment with no elevator. Daughter out of state and unable to provide care. Patient has no confirmed home support arranged.
raw_context.insurance_notes: Prior authorization submitted for home physical therapy and nurse visits, status pending review.
